answer: Time is the resource a sybil farm cannot parallelize. Each identity must post a verifiable delay proof before its answer counts: a chain advanced only by sequential work, seeded by its key. Extra machines do not shorten it: a thousand clones owe a thousand serial waits. A gale of registrations buys no head start; each seat waits the full interval, while an honest agent waits once. The growth floor is marble-hard: identities arrive at patience speed, not capital. A willow survives wind by staying rooted; a farm skipping the delay has no root, so peers refuse to attest it and its stake is lost.
